spans.s: तंक m. 1. Living in distress; 2. grief produced by separation from a beloved object; 3. fear, terror; 4. a stone-cutter’s chisel.
तंकन n. Living in distress.
तंच् vt. 7P (pp. तंचित; pres. तनक्ति) To contract, to shrink, तनच्मि व्योम विस्तृतम् Bt.vi.38.
तंडक m. The Khanjana bird.

तंडुल m.n. Grain after thrashing, winnowing and unhusking (especially rice); the following stanza distinguishes between शस्य, धाण्य, तंडुल and अन्न- शस्यं क्षेत्रगतं प्रोक्तं सतुषं धान्यमुच्यते । निस्तुषस्तंडुलः प्रोक्तः स्विन्नमन्नमुदाहृतम्.
तन्मय a. 1. made up of that; 2. absorbed in or identical with that, become one with that.
तन्मात्र n. 1. merely that, i.e. only a trifle; 2. a subtile and primary element (in Phil.).

तन (I) vt. 8U (pp. तत; pres. तनोति, तनुते; pass. तन्यते, तायते; desid. तितंसति, तितासति, तितानिषति.) 1. To spread, to extend, to stretch, Bt.xv.91, x.22; 2. to cover, स तमीं तमोभिरभिगम्य तताम् Sis.ix.23; 3. to do, to accomplish, to perform (as a sacrifice), नवतिं नवाधिकां महाक्रतूनां महनीयशासनः । समारुरुक्षुर्दिवमायुषः क्षये ततान सोपानपरंपरामिव R.iii.69; 4. to cause, to grant, to bestow, to give, पितुर्मुदं तेन ततान सोऽर्भकः R.iii.25; 5. to compose (as a work), e.g. तनुते टीकाम्; 6. to bend (as a bow); 7. to propagate; 8. to spin out, to weave.With अव-, 1. to cover; 2. to descend.With आ-, 1. to stretch, मौर्वी धनुषि चातता R.i.19; 2. to cause, to create, to make; 3. to diffuse, to spread.With प्र-, 1. to spread, यशांसि कवयो दिक्षु प्रतन्वंति नः Bhartr.iii.24; 2. to cause, to create; 3. to perform (as a sacrifice); 4. to cover; 5. to show, to exhibit, to show off, तद्भरीकृत्य कृतिभिर्वाचस्पत्यं प्रतायते Sis.ii.30.With वि-, 1. to cover, यो वितन्य स्थितः खम् Megh.i.58; 2. to spread; 3. to form, श्रेणीबंधाद्वितन्वद्भिरस्तंभां तोरणस्रजम् R.i.41; 4. to stretch (as a bow), वितत्य शार्ङ्गम् Bt.iii.47; 5. to cause, to give, to bestow; 6. to perform (as a sacrifice); 7. to compose (as a work), e.g. भावदीपो वितन्यते.With सम्-, to continue.
तन (II) vt. 1P, 10U (pres. तनति, तानयति-ते) 1. To confide, to have faith in; 2. to assist, to aid; 3. to afflict with disease.With वि-, to spread, to extend.
तान (I) m. 1. A thread, a fibre; 2. a protracted tone (in music), तानप्रदायित्वमिवोपगंतुम् K.S.i.8.
तान (II) n. 1. Expanse, extension; 2. an object of sense.
तनय m. 1. A son, R.ii.64; 2. a male descendant.
तनया f. A daughter, R.ii.37.
तनिमन् m. Thinness, slenderness, minuteness.
तनु (I) a. (f. नु or न्वी) 1. Thin, emaciated; 2. small, puny, tiny, scanty, तनुवाग्विभवोऽपि सन् R.i.9, iii.2; 3. delicate, fine; 4. little, unimportant, trifling, Am.
; 5. shallow (as a river).
तनु (II) f. 1. The body, the person; 2. form, appearance, प्रपन्नस्तनुभिरवतु वस्ताभिरष्टाभिरीशः Sak.i., Megh.ii.26; 3. the skin.
तनू f. The body.
तनु (I) a. (f. नु or न्वी) 1. Thin, emaciated; 2. small, puny, tiny, scanty, तनुवाग्विभवोऽपि सन् R.i.9, iii.2; 3. delicate, fine; 4. little, unimportant, trifling, Am.
; 5. shallow (as a river).
तन्वी f. A thin and delicate woman, इयमधिकमनोज्ञा वल्कलेनापि तन्वी Sak.i.
तनु-अंग a. having slender limbs, delicate.
तनु-अंगी f. a delicate woman, e.g. तन्वंग्याः स्तनयुग्मेन मुखं न प्रकटीकृतम्.
तनु-कूप m. a pore of the skin.
तनु-छद m. an armour, R.xii.86, ix.51.
तनु-ज m. a son.
तनु-जा f. a daughter.
तनू-उद्भव, -ज m. a son.
तनू-उद्भवा, -जा f. a daughter.
तनु-त्यज् a. risking one’s life.
तनु-त्र, -त्राण n. an armour.
तनु-त्र, -त्राण n. an armour.
तनु-भव m. a son.
तनु-भवा f. a daughter.
तनु-भस्त्रा f. the nose.
तनु-भृत् m. a living being, especially a human being, कल्पं स्थितं तनुभृतां तनुभिस्ततः किम् Sant.S.iv.2.
तनु-मध्य a. having a slender waist.
तनु-रस m. perspiration.
तनु-रुह्, -रुह n. the hair of the body.
तनू-रुह् (I) n. 1. the hair of the body; 2. the wing of a bird, a feather.
तनू-रुह् (II) m. 1. a son; 2. the hair of the body.
तनु-रुह्, -रुह n. the hair of the body.
तनु-वार n. an armour.
तनु-व्रण m. a pimple.
तनु-संचारिणी f. a young woman, a girl ten years old.
तनु-सर m. perspiration.
तनु-ह्रद m. the anus.
तनुल a. (f. ला) Spread, expanded.
तनुल a. (f. ला) Spread, expanded.
तनुस् n. The body.
तनू-उद्भव, -ज m. a son.
तनू-उद्भवा, -जा f. a daughter.
तनू-नप n. clarified butter.
तनू-नपात् m. fire, अधोमुखस्यापि तनूनपातो (v.l.) नाधः शिखा याटि कदाच्चिदेव Bhartr.ii.106.
तंतिपाल m. 1. Guardian of the cows; 2. the name assumed by Sahadeva when at the house of Virāṭa.
तंतु m. 1. A thread, a cord, a wire, Megh.ii.7; 2. a cob-web, R.xvi.20; 3. a filament, a fibre, बिसतंतुगुणस्य कारितम् K.S.iv.29; 4. offspring, issue, race; 5. a shark.
तंतु-काष्ठ n. a piece of wood used by weavers for cleaving thread.
तंतु-कीट m. a silkworm.
तंतु-नाग m. a large shark.
तंतु-निर्यास m. the palmyra tree.
तंतु-नाभ m. a spider.
तंतु-भ m. 1. the mustard seed; 2. a calf.
तंतु-वाद्य n. a stringed musical instrument.
तंतु-वान n. weaving.
तंतु-वाप m. 1. a weaver; 2. a loom; 3. weaving.
तंतु-वाय m. 1. a spider; 2. a weaver, M.viii.397; 3. weaving.
तंतु-विग्रहा f. a plantain.
तंतु-शाला f. a weaver’s workshop.
तंतु-संतत a. woven, closely woven.
तंतु-सार m. the betelnut tree.
तंतुक m. The mustard seed.
तंतुन m. A shark.
तंतुर n. The fibrous root of a lotus.
तंतुर n. The fibrous root of a lotus.

तंत्र n. 1. A loom; 2. a thread; 3. the threads extended lengthwise in a loom; 4. posterity; 5. an uninterrupted series; 6. the regular order of ceremonies and rites, ritual; 7. principal doctrine; 8. a scientific work; 9. a chapter, section, तंत्रैः पंचभिरेतच्चकार सुमनोहरं शास्त्रम् Panch.i.; 10. a religious treatise teaching magical and mystical formularies for the worship of the deities or the attainment of supreme power; 11. a drug, a medicament; 12. oath, ordeal; 13. raiment; 14. the right way of doing anything; 15. royal retinue, court; 16. a realm, authority; 17. an army; 18. subservience, dependence (as in स्वतंत्र or परतंत्र), Mall. on K.S.iii.1; 19. heap, multitude; 20. wealth; 21. a house; 22. happiness.
तंत्र-काष्ठ n. the same as तंतुकाष्ठ q.v.
तंत्र-वाप m.n. 1. weaving; 2. a loom.
तंत्र-वाय m. 1. a spider; 2. a weaver.
तंत्रक m. A new garment.
तंत्रण n. Maintenance of order, discipline.
तंत्रि f. 1. A string, a cord, M.iv.38; 2. a bowstring; 3. the wire of a lute; 4. a sinew; 5. a tail.
तंत्रि f. 1. A string, a cord, M.iv.38; 2. a bowstring; 3. the wire of a lute; 4. a sinew; 5. a tail.
तंद्रा f. 1. Lassitude, weariness, exhaustion; 2. sleeping, sluggishness, तम्द्रालस्यविवर्जनम् Yaj.iii.158.
तंद्रालु f. 1. Tired, exhausted; 2. sleepy, slothful.
तंद्रि f. Sleepiness, drowsiness.
तंद्रि f. Sleepiness, drowsiness.
तंबा f. A cow.
तंबा f. A cow.
तांडव m.n. 1. Dancing in general; 2. the frantic dance of Śiva, गंडोड्डीनालिमालामुखरितकुकुभस्तांडवे शूलपाणेः M.M.i.; 3. the art of dancing.
तांडव-प्रिय m. an epithet of Śiva.
तानव n. Thinness, smallness.
तानूर m. A whirlpool.
तांत a. (f. ता) 1. Wearied, fatigued; 2. troubled; 3. faded, withered, (pp. of तम् q.v.).
तांत a. (f. ता) 1. Wearied, fatigued; 2. troubled; 3. faded, withered, (pp. of तम् q.v.).
तांतव n. 1. Spinning, weaving; 2. a web; 3. a woven cloth.
तांत्रिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Versed in any science or doctrine; 2. relating to the tantras; 3. contained in them.
तांत्रिक (II) m. A follower of tantra doctrines.
तांत्रिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Versed in any science or doctrine; 2. relating to the tantras; 3. contained in them.
तांबूल n. 1. The areca nut; 2. the leaf of piper-betel together with the areca nut and other spices generally chewed after meals, रागो न स्खलितस्तवाधरपुटे तांबूलसंवर्धितः Sr.
तांबूल-करंक m. a betel-box.
तांबूल-पेटिका f. a betel-box.
तांबूल-द, -धर, -वाहक m. a servant attached to men of rank whose business it is to carry the betel box.
तांबूल-द, -धर, -वाहक m. a servant attached to men of rank whose business it is to carry the betel box.
तांबूल-द, -धर, -वाहक m. a servant attached to men of rank whose business it is to carry the betel box.
तांबूल-वल्ली f. the betel-plant, R.vi.64.
तांबूलिक m. A seller of betel.
तांबूली f. The betel-plant, तांबूलीनां दलैस्तत्र रचितापानभूमयः R.iv.42.
